# M/s NRSR & Co — Chartered Accountants

> M/s NRSR & Co is a partnership firm of Chartered Accountants (Est. 2019) providing full-scope Audit & Assurance, Direct & Indirect Tax Litigation, Business Valuation, Corporate Structuring, and Virtual CFO services across Karnataka and India.

## Key Information
- Firm: M/s NRSR & Co (Chartered Accountants)
- Founded: 2019
- Accreditations: ICAI Peer Reviewed Firm | ISO 9001:2015 Certified
- Primary Email: info@nrsrandco.com
- Manipal HQ: 'Gokula', 1st Floor, Union Bank Building, Opp. Green Park Hotel, Near Tiger Circle, Manipal - 576104 (Phone: +91 77604 85737 / +91 63605 23673)
- Bengaluru Branch: 17/106, 3rd Cross, LG Ramanna Extension, Laggere, Bengaluru, Karnataka - 560058 (Phone: +91 88675 31151 / +91 78298 09690)
- Official Website: https://nrsrandco.com
- Employee Practice Portal: https://practice.turia.in/login

## Practice Verticals & Services
1. Direct Taxation & Tax Audit: Full-scope Income Tax compliance, strategic tax planning, 12A/80G registrations, Form 15CA/15CB remittances, Tax Audits u/s 44AB.
2. Indirect Taxation (GST): GST registrations, monthly/annual filings (GSTR-9/9C), refund processing, audit defense under Section 65, DRC-01 notice replies.
3. Tax Litigation & Appeals: Drafting appeals, stay of demand petitions, CIT(Appeals) and ITAT tribunal representations.
4. Corporate Advisory & MCA/ROC: Private Ltd / LLP incorporation, secretarial compliances (AOC-4, MGT-7), DIR-3 KYC, capital changes.
5. Business Valuation & Advisory: DCF Enterprise Valuation, Rule 11UA / Income Tax valuations, FEMA & FDI inbound valuations, ESOP fairness valuations.
6. Audit & Assurance: Statutory company audits under Companies Act 2013, internal controls design (SOPs), society/trust audits.
7. Virtual CFO & Financial Advisory: Working capital management, CMA data, loan syndication, cash flow forecasting, MIS dashboards.
8. Start-ups & Special Registrations: DPIIT Startup India recognition, Section 80-IAC tax holiday applications, MSME/Udyam registrations.
9. International Tax & Transfer Pricing: Rule 10D documentation, Form 3CEB, DTAA treaty relief advisory, cross-border structuring.
10. Trust & NGO Services: Section 12AB & 80G registrations, CSR-1 filings, FCRA compliances.
